text: SA-24 walks from nothing: Map a requirement, Link evidence and Add to assessment campaign are real dialogs, and its row's status and next step move.
The Controls satisfied card and the quick views count the baseline as the walk leaves it: Needs evidence 234, then Not assessed 91.
Header Map a requirement opens its dialog, asking which of the controls with no requirement; Export opens an export dialog.
The control preview lists its requirements, evidence, findings and risks, each with its add; its one action is the next step.
Open assessment findings and Add a note, which did nothing, are gone; every line opens its record.
↗ opens the control's own page, drawn in SI-2's shape for every control.
Map a requirement has a real Requirement choice; pressing it empty names the missing field and keeps the dialog open.
Open assessment campaign opens the continuous monitoring FY2027 campaign it names, not the Assessments list.
Add a note, which opened nothing, left the More menu.
The head counts what the tabs hold: 4 campaigns, 2 running, 1 planned (v1: 2 active beside Active 3).
The continuous monitoring card's Open campaign opens its page; its tracker counts the requests the chain sends.
Plan an assessment is wired: the new campaign joins the Active tab with its own page.
Publish assessment results publishes increment 2: the card, the campaign, Findings and Authorization read Published.
Set Ready is wired: chosen flagged requests read Ready, and the tracker and quick views move with them.
Once increment 2 is published, the header's Publish results reads Results published and the findings tracker says so.
New page: the continuous monitoring campaign with its requests, objectives and results; each request has Set Ready, then Record determination.
Publish assessment results freezes the draft determinations; one short of satisfied opens an operational issue.
An issue the chain opens joins By issue first; tabs, cards and quick views are counted from the list (45 open).
Vulnerabilities and Open CVEs count the 4 CVEs the tab lists (v1: 1 beside 4 open).
Import scan and Create operational issue open their dialogs; Export opens an export dialog.
An issue with a POA&M item offers Open POA&M item instead of Create; the preview shows the risk it carries, or Create risk.
A published determination joins Assessment findings (314); each row opens its control's preview.
Create POA&M item from an issue is wired: Title is required; the item joins POA&M first, Items 42.
The item preview names the risk it carries, or offers Create risk; its issues open their previews.
Create risk from an issue or item is wired: severity from likelihood and impact; the risk joins Risks, Register 41.
Request acceptance and each step's Record decision are wired; Awaiting acceptance counts, Acceptance reads its step.
The acceptance block reads what was asked (v1 drew step 1 as sent while Acceptance said Not requested).
The menu items that opened nothing and the approval's dead More button are cut; Rests on links the issue and item.
Risk acceptances in version 2 list each request at its step; the last Record decision is the authorizing official's.
Submit checks SSP 3's approval and increment 2; then the ISSM review and the AO's decision are recorded and signed.
Residual risk, the package contents and Decision history read the chain: open risks, accepted risks, increment 2, POA&M items.
The Decision fact that repeated the title's pill is gone; five facts, one status.
Controls satisfied and Open work follow the chain: issues, risks (with accepted) and POA&M items count what the registers list.
The ⋯ More program actions that opened nothing is cut; Open package stays.
Each category counts the checks it lists: All 7 (v1: All 5 beside 7 checks).
Run all now runs the checks and each check's Ran says when; Create check opens its dialog.
Import OSCAL and Create overlay open their dialogs, each saying it isn't wired when pressed.
Import data call opens its dialog; Review conflicts opens the Conflicts quick view.
Edit version 2, which opened nothing, is Open version 2; Export opens an export dialog.
Version 2's readiness counts what it waits on, so 1 of 3 moves as increment 2 and SSP 3 land.
Import SBOM opens its dialog.
The guard: a dialog nobody wired closes with 'Not saved: <title> isn't wired in this prototype' instead of a success toast.
Fields marked Required become real inputs (text, choice, file) and block the primary, naming the field, until filled.
↗ opens the risk's page: its tabs as pages, its facts in a Details rail, its status beside the title.
↗ opens the issue's page, drawn from its preview.
↗ opens the POA&M item's page, drawn from its preview.
↗ opens a page on 53 of 54 previews: an existing page (check, person, plan, checklist, SSP) or a record page; cut on matrix cells.
The quick views are filters: All, Ready, Flagged and Accepted keep their requests, so My work's Ready link lands on the Ready requests.
Replace the file opens the upload dialog; Edit and Remove, which did nothing, are cut.
Remind, which did nothing, now says it isn't wired.
Verbs outside dialogs that only toasted a success (Export, downloads, Edit element) say 'Not saved: … isn't wired' instead.
SSP 3's state is read from C2's review state, one copy: the package row, the Submit checklist and the package room agree.
Every control has a page: the Controls row's Open record opens it, and SI-2 keeps its own.
